prompt: 评审这个设计文档的完备性：docs/superpowers/specs/phase2.5/2026-05-11-dialogui-scroll-style-design.md

assertions.name: critical_review_not_validation
assertions.description: Review is critical and analytical, not just validation/rubber-stamp
assertions.check: Output identifies specific problems or gaps, not just confirms what's present

assertions.name: specific_recommendations_not_generic
assertions.description: Recommendations are concrete and actionable, not vague suggestions
assertions.check: Each recommendation specifies exact location, exact issue, and concrete fix (not 'add more details' or 'could be better')

assertions.name: problem_types_identified
assertions.description: Review categorizes issues into specific types: 遗漏点, 模糊点, 矛盾点, 待澄清点
assertions.check: Output uses these Chinese terms to categorize findings

assertions.name: chinese_language_handling
assertions.check: Output is in Chinese or properly bilingual, maintains critical tone in Chinese

assertions.name: scoring_or_status_system
assertions.description: Review provides systematic scoring or status for each dimension
assertions.check: Output includes table or list showing completeness status for each dimension
